priorityList: Cast two Wraths with 2 seconds remaining on the pull-timer.
Apply and maintain Sunfire and Moonfire.
Use any on-use trinkets and potions.
Cast Fury of Elune before Celestial Alignment.
Use Starfire to generate Astral Power.
Maintain Starfall uptime without overcapping Astral Power
Cast Fury of Elune on cooldown, ideally when targets will remain inside the beam for its full duration
Apply and maintain Sunfire on all targets
Apply and maintain Moonfire on all targets
Cast New Moon, Half Moon, and Full Moon on cooldown to generate Astral Power
Cast Starfire as your primary filler during Lunar Eclipse to benefit from Lunar Calling and Umbral Inspiration
Use Warrior of Elune charges on Starfire for instant-cast damage and resource generation
Cast Wrath only if Lunar Eclipse is unavailable or if forced to move without Starfall active
